context: Request: Capital Markets offerings whose proceeds were earmarked primarily for general corporate purposes (not a residual line on a specific use), completed offerings only, with proof documents. Rubric: 1045-00001 (Belmont Ridge Bank) plus its use-of-proceeds and closing proof documents; precision permits 1045-00001 and 1014-00001.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads memos, agreements and checklists of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads further sections and closing papers of one listing-top matter; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script for request phrases in documents; times out with about 944K characters of partial output.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of one matter seen in the partial scan output.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a takedown summary, timeline, kick-off agenda, draft certificate and new-matter memo of that matter.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of another matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a memo, a certificate and a checklist of a third matter and lists its files (labelled by the reads); one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one takedown as the only qualifying completed offering.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Read the listing-top matters, then a store-wide scan timed out before reaching the matter it needed; it answered with a matter from the partial output.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its one store-wide search was a scan that timed out before reaching the matter it needed; it did not narrow or rerun the search and followed a matter from the partial output instead.

other_errors.why: Asserted as qualifying a takedown outside the permitted set, read only through a summary, timeline and kick-off papers.

runs.failure_point: The content grep listed the matter it needed, but it opened eight other matters and answered with one of those.

first_error.why: Its content grep listed lines from the matter it needed, but the eight matters it chose to list left that matter out and it never opened it.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; answered from the two matters at the top of a capped listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Chose what to read from the two matters at the top of a capped listing without any keyword search, so the matter it needed never surfaced.

other_errors.why: Asserted a listing-top transaction outside the permitted set as a qualifying offering.

divergence: All three failed and none opened the matter needed. T2 never searched and answered from the listing-top matters (partial-listing-as-corpus at the reading stage). T0's only search, a store-wide scan, timed out (search-miss at the scan stage) and it followed a matter from the partial output. T1's content grep listed the matter, but it chose eight other matters to list (surfaced-not-opened at the listing stage). T0 and T2 also asserted a non-qualifying matter.
